<div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-2xl 2xl:max-w-3xl xl:w-[calc(100%-13rem)]">

    </p>

<section data-home-intro className="py-16 lg:py-20">
  <div className="mx-auto mb-10 max-w-2xl text-center">
    <h2 className="mt-0 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#593e2e] dark:text-[#F2E6D8] sm:text-4xl">
      From rough request to review-ready pull request
    </h2>
    <p className="mx-auto mt-5 max-w-xl text-lg leading-8 text-[#593e2e]/80 dark:text-[#F2E6D8]">
      Bring PRFlow a user story or an existing issue. It shapes the work, carries it through implementation and verification, and prepares the pull request for your review.
    </p>
  </div>

  <CardGroup cols={2}>
    <Card title="Start with a Request" icon="rocket" href="/docs/getting-started/index">
      Bring a rough user story or existing issue. PRFlow helps shape it into implementation-ready work.
    </Card>
    <Card title="Choose a Workflow" icon="route" href="/docs/workflows/index">
      Create, implement, review, fix or document work with the workflow that matches the outcome you need.
    </Card>
    <Card title="Run Where You Work" icon="terminal" href="/docs/runs/index">
      Use PRFlow in a supported coding client, or add optional cloud automation for your repository.
    </Card>
    <Card title="Explore PRFlow" icon="github" href="https://github.com/The01Geek/prflow">
      Browse the source, releases and issue tracker behind the project.
    </Card>
    <Card title="What's New" icon="sparkles" href="/release-notes">
      Read the release notes for the latest user-visible changes, fixes and upgrade notes.
    </Card>
  </CardGroup>
</section>

<section data-home-path className="border-t border-[#593e2e]/35 py-16 lg:py-20">
  <div className="mb-10">
    <p className="mb-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#593e2e] dark:text-[#F2E6D8]">
      A complete delivery loop
    </p>
    <h2 className="mt-0 text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#593e2e] dark:text-[#F2E6D8] sm:text-4xl">
      One request. One accountable delivery path.
    </h2>
    <p className="mt-5 max-w-2xl text-lg leading-8 text-[#593e2e]/80 dark:text-[#F2E6D8]">
      PRFlow keeps the specification, implementation evidence, review findings and documentation connected from the first request to the final handoff.
    </p>
  </div>

  <Steps>
    <Step title="Shape the Work">
      Start with a rough user story or existing issue. PRFlow can turn the story into an implementation-ready specification with clear acceptance criteria.
    </Step>
    <Step title="Implement and Verify">
      PRFlow works in the real repository, makes the authorized changes, runs available checks and records anything it could not verify.
    </Step>
    <Step title="Review and Improve">
      Independent review passes identify evidence-backed findings and apply authorized corrections before handoff.
    </Step>
    <Step title="Document and Hand Off">
      Relevant documentation and the pull request description are brought up to date for your final review and merge.
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</section>

<section data-home-handoff className="mb-20 rounded-2xl border border-[#593e2e] bg-[#F2E6D8] p-6 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(89,62,46,0.12)] dark:bg-[#593e2e] sm:p-8">
  <h2 className="mt-0 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#593e2e] dark:text-[#F2E6D8]">
    Built for human-controlled delivery
  </h2>
  <p className="mt-4 leading-7 text-[#593e2e]/80 dark:text-[#F2E6D8]">
    Use PRFlow in a supported coding client, or add optional GitHub automation for cloud runs. Start with the <a href="/docs/getting-started/installation">installation guide</a>, or read <a href="/docs/concepts/index">how PRFlow works</a>.
  </p>
  <p className="mb-0 mt-4 leading-7 text-[#593e2e]/80 dark:text-[#F2E6D8]">
    PRFlow prepares the work; it does not merge it. Your repository protections and normal approval process remain in control.
  </p>
</section>

</div>

</div>
